cells.value: Clean construction techniques: For compressor and positive displacement pump piping prior to fabrication: Sand or grit blasting for rust and scale removal together with "clean" weld techniques (TIG, MIG, etc.) for all closing welds. For steam generators, this includes use of cold drawn tubing and cold bending.
Post fabrication mechanical cleaning: Grinding, pigging, sand or grit blasting (except adjacent to machinery), or high pressure (>5000 psi) water blasting.
Flushing with fresh clean potable water to remove trash and debris.
Alkaline detergent wash for oil and grease removal.
Solvent cleaning with acids or chelants, for rust and mill scale removal.
Post cleaning passivation: Prevention of after-rusting of cleaned surfaces by chemical treatment.

Post cleaning protection: Vapor phase inhibitor coating with a lubricant compatible rust preventive except for non-lubricated compressors and those in refrigeration service, or nitrogen blanket. Systems constructed entirely of stainless steel do not require the above. Blind, plug, or cap all piping joints left temporarily disconnected.
